verdict.rationale: Orb is a SaaS billing platform that holds customer usage and billing data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is used for AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy. The MCP server and test-mode items concern agent access and isolating live billing data, not training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
